keyPhrases.text: generosity of substance and spirit rarely seen on the stage anymore
directed with sweeping passion and meticulous care
theater as charged and cluttered and expansive as life itself

reasoning: This is clearly a rave review with consistent superlative language throughout ('glorious feast,' 'thrilling,' 'endlessly vibrant'). Multiple performances and production elements receive enthusiastic praise with no meaningful criticisms presented in the excerpt.
